{{Quote|I have met these reclusive cretins and listened to their singsong prophecies. They do possess the gift of futuresight, which proved useful to my forces at the Battle of Dromund Kaas.|Asajj Ventress, on the Prophets of the Dark Side in her annotation to ''Wild Power''|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
The '''Battle of Dromund Kaas''' occurred on<ref name="Book of Sith" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]],<ref name="Book of Sith" /> once the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Timeline">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}}</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Guide" /> which lasted between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> The [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] participated in the battle,<ref name="Guide" /> as did forces led by the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="Book of Sith" /> During the battle, Ventress used the [[Force vision/Legends|precognitive]] abilities of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]] to her forces' benefit. She later mentioned her experience in an annotation made in ''[[Wild Power]]'', a manifesto written by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Clone Wars conflict on Dromund Kaas was first mentioned in "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," an article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 84|eighty-fourth issue]] of the magazine ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''<ref name="Guide" /> on [[September 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref> It was first identified as the Battle of Dromund Kaas in ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', an [[in-universe]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[2012]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
